name: nist-tn1838-first-floor
note: A dimensioned CAD floor plan of a house, drawn in metres on a US letter page. mmPerUnit is measured from the drawing itself: the outer walls are the 0.85 pt strokes forming a 287.2 by 102.96 pt rectangle, and the report gives the footprint as 17.15 m by 6.15 m, so one page point is 59.72 mm within a fraction of a percent (both directions agree). The plan names no rooms, so room recall is not scored; doors and windows are drawn from a legend with sizes written beside them rather than a repeated symbol, so an honest count is not possible without tracing every opening.
